raw_response:
This is my main plot, and maize is what feeds my family, so I must do my best on it. I will try to use the FISP coupon if I can get one — that gives me one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I will also plant hybrid seed from the coupon. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I carry some manure to the field before the rains. I cannot afford pesticide, and we have no way to irrigate — we wait for the rains like everyone else here in Mangochi. My wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, but for weeding I may call a few young men for ganyu if the weeds come fast after the first rains.
